The '''Cardua system''' was a [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located at Grid coordinates L-10, near the [[Xorth system/Legends|Xorth system]], which was conquered by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The people were then forced to mine the [[Cardua asteroid belts]].<ref name="TSC" />
